fields.Name: R3 -> S4.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.15 (phase 2, dataset R3, criterion S4.3): on R3 a count target ranks and gates on Poisson deviance; its GLM baseline is the reference pipeline's Poisson GLM (holdout deviance within 1e-6 of it), and what the gate ships scores at most 1.1713 on the 3,000 held-out rows, with 0 negative predictions, 1 of 1. It fails when the count objective falls back to squared error, for the Poisson GLM baseline and the boosted candidates alike (the GLM baseline's Poisson deviance 1.8163 departs from the reference pipeline's 1.1190).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Poisson deviance is the primary score on R3; the GLM baseline matches the reference pipeline's and the shipped model scores at most 1.1713 with no negative counts (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
